cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
for f in sez_random.py ext_fetch.py; do curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/$f" -o /tmp/$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }; done
rm -f /tmp/ext.log /tmp/sez2.log
( nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/ext_fetch.py > /tmp/ext.log 2>&1; EXTRA_DIR=data_ext nice -n 19 timeout 2400 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/sez_random.py 400 > /tmp/sez2.log 2>&1 ) > /dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 100
tail -n 25 /tmp/ext.log
